design_export: 39_design.npz: minute stamps, month index, decile, pre-onset flag, counts per cell, M0 alert positions; no prices
null_model: Q_nu of notebook 34 (uniform over alert sets with the observed counts per calendar month x RV decile and spacing >= 240 minutes)

outputs.odds_ratios: exact step odds ratio OR_v(t, H) = odds under weights v / odds under Q at every free decision of the observed M0 path and of N_DRAW exact draws from Q; max |log OR| / log Gamma per weighting; each value is a lower bound on the design constant kappa_D(Gamma)
outputs.packing: per cell: eligible minutes, greedy maximum number of alerts with spacing >= 240 (K_c), count nu_c, nu_c / K_c
outputs.weighted_tails: exact P_{Q_v}(T >= T_obs) under fixed weightings v on a Gamma grid; each is a lower bound on the Rosenbaum-type worst-case p, hence an upper bound on Gamma*

readings: kappa lower bounds and Gamma* upper bounds only; no lower bound on Gamma* follows from this notebook (that needs a proof of kappa_D(Gamma) <= Gamma^k); packing is descriptive; development sample was inspected repeatedly, so every output is exploratory
status: exploratory; appendix; no confirmatory plan changed
title: Design-specific relation between a Rosenbaum-type Gamma and the step-wise Lambda in M0's development design (exploratory; appendix)

weightings.avoid_block: 1 on the 239 minutes before each pre-onset window start, Gamma elsewhere
weightings.cell_constant: check only: a constant per (month, decile) cell; every admissible set has the same weight, so OR must equal 1
weightings.phase: Gamma on minutes whose 240-minute phase since the month start is even
weightings.tilt_avoid: Gamma on pre-onset minutes, 1 on the 239 minutes before each pre-onset window start, sqrt(Gamma) elsewhere
